name: Kneringerhof
beschreibung: The Kneringerhof is situated in a quiet location in the Ötztal in Tirol and is surrounded by an impressive mountain backdrop. The surroundings invite extended hikes in summer and ski tours in winter. The amenities of the family-run inn include comfortable rooms, a cozy dining room with fireplace, and a kitchen with regional specialties. The atmosphere is traditional and warm, with attentive service. The target group is primarily active holidaymakers who want to enjoy nature, as well as those seeking relaxation.
